/* Template:Skilltree/styles.css - the skill tree window. Tiles are 60px. A skill tile is the output of Module:Skill
   (.aa-skill-set: the :target anchors, the icons of the tile .aa-tileicons and the cards .aa-varset). The cards open
   at the side of the tile on hover, starting halfway down the tile (so the pointer can still pass over the upper half of
   the next tile): to the right in a tree with .aa-tree-tips-right (a tree on the left of the page),
   to the left in .aa-tree-tips-left (float=right). A closed card has no size (width and height 0) so it does not widen
   the page. The card touches the tile (a transparent strip of 4px), so the pointer can move into it to switch the
   version or the chain of a skill; the icon of the tile then follows the card that is shown. */
.aa-tree {
  position: relative;
  display: inline-block;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  padding: 12px 16px 16px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  color: #e8e4d8;
  font-size: 13px;
  vertical-align: top;
}
.aa-tree-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  min-height: 38px;
  margin: 0 0 8px;
}
.aa-tree-head-p {
  min-height: 0;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}
.aa-tree-name {
  margin: 6px 0 -8px;
  color: #f1e6c0;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: bold;
  line-height: 22px;
  text-align: left;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000;
}
.aa-tree-title {
  color: #e9d9a8;
  font-size: 17px;
  font-weight: bold;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px #000;
}
.aa-tree-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 60px);
  gap: 10px;
  margin: 0 0 10px;
}
.aa-tree-tile {
  position: relative;
  width: 60px;
  height: 60px;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  border: 2px solid #0a0c12;
  background: #0a0c12;
  outline: 1px solid #4a4a50;
  cursor: default;
}
.aa-tree-ico {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
  line-height: 56px;
  text-align: center;
  color: #888;
}
.aa-tree-ico img {
  display: block;
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
}
.aa-tree-tile:hover,
.aa-tree-tile:focus {
  outline-color: #e9d9a8;
}
/* a skill that is clicked open (focus): above the layer, everything else in the tree is covered by it (not hoverable) */
.aa-tree-shield {
  display: none;
}
.aa-tree-tile:focus ~ .aa-tree-shield {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 50;
}
.aa-tree-tile:focus {
  z-index: 60;
}
/* the box that opens on hover or focus */
.aa-tree-tip {
  display: none;
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 100;
  top: 50%;
  left: 100%;
  padding: 0 0 0 4px;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: normal;
  cursor: auto;
}
.aa-tree-tips-left .aa-tree-tip {
  left: auto;
  right: 100%;
  padding: 0 4px 0 0;
}
.aa-tree-tile:hover > .aa-tree-tip,
.aa-tree-tile:focus > .aa-tree-tip {
  display: block;
}
.aa-tree-tip .aa-skill {
  margin: 0;
}
/* Abyssal: the eye (toggle) sits at the top right of the tree. It has three pictures of the sprite sheet: open (red),
   closed (grey) and the shiny one under the pointer. The grey one shows while the Abyssal row (the collapsible before
   the eye) is collapsed. The row keeps its space when it is closed. */
.aa-tree-spr {
  display: block;
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  top: 0;
  width: 57px;
  height: 38px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.aa-tree-spr img {
  position: absolute;
  left: -192px;
  max-width: none;
}
.aa-tree-aby {
  min-height: 70px;
}
.aa-tree-eye {
  position: absolute;
  top: 14px;
  left: 50%;
  margin-left: -28px;
  width: 57px;
  height: 38px;
  cursor: pointer;
  /* centred, 30% larger, grown sideways and down from its top middle */
  transform: scale(1.3);
  transform-origin: top center;
}
.aa-tree-eye .aa-tree-spr {
  display: none;
}
.aa-tree-eye .aa-eye-on {
  display: block;
}
.aa-tree-eye .aa-eye-on img {
  top: 0;
}
.aa-tree-eye .aa-eye-hover img {
  top: -37.5px;
}
.aa-tree-eye .aa-eye-off img {
  top: -112.5px;
}
.mw-collapsed ~ .aa-tree-eye .aa-eye-on {
  display: none;
}
.mw-collapsed ~ .aa-tree-eye .aa-eye-off {
  display: block;
}
.aa-tree-eye:hover .aa-tree-spr {
  display: none;
}
.aa-tree-eye:hover .aa-eye-hover {
  display: block;
}
.aa-tree-abp {
  min-height: 60px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.aa-tree-abp .aa-tree-grid {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}
.aa-tree-hl {
  color: #ffa633;
}
/* a skill tile: icon and cards come from Module:Skill */
.aa-tree-tile > .aa-skill-set {
  display: block;
}
.aa-tileicons,
.aa-ti img {
  width: 56px;
  height: 56px;
}
.aa-ti {
  display: none;
}
.aa-ti img {
  display: block;
}
.aa-ti-main {
  display: block;
}
.aa-pick:target ~ .aa-tileicons > .aa-ti-main {
  display: none;
}
.aa-tree-tile .aa-varset {
  position: absolute;
  z-index: 100;
  top: 50%;
  left: 100%;
  width: 0;
  height: 0;
  max-width: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  padding: 0 0 0 4px;
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: normal;
  cursor: auto;
}
.aa-tree-tips-left .aa-tree-tile .aa-varset {
  left: auto;
  right: 100%;
  padding: 0 4px 0 0;
}
.aa-tree-tile:hover .aa-varset,
.aa-tree-tile:focus .aa-varset {
  width: auto;
  height: auto;
  overflow: visible;
}
.aa-tree-tile .aa-skill {
  margin: 0;
}
/* the icon of the card that is shown (6 versions, 10 chain positions) */
.aa-pick-v1.aa-pick-k1:target ~ .aa-tileicons > .aa-ti-v1.aa-ti-k1 {

/* the box of a passive */
.aa-tree-ptip {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 300px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(24, 28, 38, 0.97), rgba(10, 12, 18, 0.97));
  border: 1px solid #5a5040;
  border-radius: 3px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #000, 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  line-height: 1.5;
}
.aa-tree-phead {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}
.aa-tree-picon img {
  display: block;
  width: 40px;
  height: 40px;
}
.aa-tree-pkind {
  color: #bdb6a4;
  font-size: 12px;
}
.aa-tree-pname {
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: bold;
}
.aa-tree-sep {
  height: 0;
  margin: 7px 0;
  border-top: 1px solid #3c3a36;
}
.aa-tree-ptext {
  color: #e8e4d8;
}

/* the watermark at the bottom of the tree: laid over the bottom edge, so the tree does not get taller; it sits in
   the free space beside the single Abyssal passive */
.aa-tree-mark {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 19px;
  left: 50%;
  margin: 0 0 0 -30px;
  line-height: 0;
  opacity: 0.7;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.aa-tree-mark img {
  display: block;
}
